sources.title: Get started with Claude in Chrome
Use Claude in Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

folds.text: Claude is not one app. It shows up in many places, and your chats, projects and memory sync across web, desktop and mobile. Right now: {{facts.apps}}.
**Web, desktop and mobile** are the everyday chat. Start here. The phone app goes where you go, and can hand a task to Cowork on your computer.
**Claude Code** is for working on code, and **Cowork** takes bigger tasks with many steps. Cowork needs the desktop app to reach files, and only in folders you connect.
**Chrome and Google Workspace** put Claude beside the page or file you have open, so you do not copy and paste. **Excel and PowerPoint** have Claude extensions too.

folds.prompt: Which app fits the job? Tap the basket.

items.text: Hand a task from my phone to Cowork on my computer
items.why: The phone app can pair with the desktop app.

items.text: Fix a bug in a software project
Have Claude work on the web page I am viewing
items.why: The extension works inside your browser.

items.text: Get Claude's help inside my Excel budget file
Carry Claude with me and chat on my phone
